f.read-aloud.muted: Sound is off. Turn it on with the sound button at the top, then try again.
f.read-aloud.no_voice: No English voice is installed on this device. Add one in the device's text-to-speech settings, then try again.
f.read-aloud.error: Reading aloud failed. Try again in a moment.
f.read-aloud.no_voice_win: No English voice is installed on this computer. In Windows: Settings, Time and language, Speech, Add voices, then choose English. Then close the browser fully and open it again.
f.read-aloud.no_voice_mac: No English voice is installed on this computer. On Mac: System Settings, Accessibility, Spoken Content, System Voice, Manage Voices, then choose English. Then close the browser and open it again.
